profile.ja: 魔女。陰陽師を養成する組織・五行学園で魔術科主任の教師を務めている。“大洋の魔女”と称される高名な魔女で、水属性の魔術の超エキスパート。双葉・リリー・ラムセスが引き起こした事件を解決するために奔走している。
profile.en: She is a witch and a teacher of magic at Gosha Academy, where she serves as the head of the magic department. Known as the Witch of the Ocean, she is a renowned expert in water-based magic. She is currently working to resolve the incident caused by Futaba Lily Ramses.

text.ja: 五行学園教師で魔術科の主任、森乃由子です。あなたの先生と言うわけではないですけれど呼ばれ慣れていますから由子先生と呼んでくださいね♪
text.en: I'm Morino Yuuko, the head of the magic department and a teacher at Gosha Academy. I'm not your teacher, per se, but I'm used to being called Yuuko, so please, call me that, okay?

text.ja: 学校自体が違っても、学生はどこか共通点がありますね。何かに一生懸命打ち込んだり、たまにサボったり……ね
text.en: Even if the school is different, students all have something in common. They're always pouring their hearts into something or skipping class every now and then, right?

text.ja: 魔法の観点から見ても、忍法は興味深いですね。遺伝特性、個人の力量差……調べてみる価値は高いです
text.en: From a magical perspective, ninja techniques are really interesting. The genetic factors, the differences in individual strength... they're definitely worth looking into.

text.ja: 私の授業ではたまにレクリエーションをしたりするんです。だって、その方が楽しいでしょう♪
text.en: In my classes, we occasionally have some fun and games. I mean, it's more fun that way, right?

text.ja: 問題児って言われる子は私の教え子にもいますよ。でも……ふふ、そういう子もとても可愛いと思うんです
text.en: I have some problem students among my pupils, too. But... I think those kids are really cute, too.

text.ja: あなたと雷撃の子の関係って、とある私の教え子の関係に似ていますね。そうやって否定するところが特に
text.en: Your relationship with the Thunderclad kid reminds me of one of my students' relationships. The way you deny it is particularly...

text.ja: “大洋の魔女”って呼ばれる事もあります。これでも魔女の中ではかなり有名なんですよ？
text.en: I'm also known as the Witch of the Ocean. I'm pretty famous among witches, you know?

text.ja: 対魔忍の衣装ってすごいですね……え？　私の服はちゃんとした魔女の装束です。全然違うと思いますよ？
text.en: Taimanin outfits are amazing, aren't they? Eh? My clothes are a proper witch's attire, though. I think they're completely different.
